note_text: Colonoscopy: Ulceroinfiltrative mass at Ascending colon, 4.7 cm in size, occupying about 79% of the lumen. Multiple biopsies taken. Impression: Ascending colon cancer, r/o adenocarcinoma. Biopsy pending.

CT abdomen and pelvis (contrast). Wall thickening of the ascending colon (4.7 cm) with no significant regional lymphadenopathy. No distant metastasis. Impression: ascending colon cancer, c300.
